description: The Enterprise IEC 60287 calculation: the continuous current rating of one circuit of three single cores of a medium or high voltage design, in trefoil or flat, buried direct, in buried ducts (one cable in each) or in free air, bonded at both ends, single-point or cross-bonded, at the site conditions sent (IEC 60287-1-1:2006+A1:2014 and IEC 60287-2-1:2015, read at standard level page by page): every step (the a.c. resistance with ys and yp, the dielectric loss, the screen loss factors, T1, T3, T4, the losses) with its value, unit, clause and page, the notes on what was taken and, where no rating is given, the reasons. Where the site is unknown, the values of IEC 60287-3-1:2017, 4.2, Tables 1 and 2, p. 7 stand (1 m, ground 20 °C, air 25 °C, soil 1.0 K·m/W). Not covered: armour, corrugated sheaths, three-core cables, drying out of the soil, cyclic loads, duct banks, crossings. Always paid, at its own Enterprise-grade price: on the site an Enterprise member's calculation. input: {laying: buried | duct | air, formation: trefoil | flat, bonding: both | single | cross, freq?: 50 | 60, spacingMm? (axis to axis; absent: touching), depthM? (default 1), soil? (K·m/W, default 1), groundC? (default 20), airC? (default 25), duct?: {material: pe | pvc | earthenware, innerMm, outerMm} (laying duct), solar? (W/m², laying air; absent: shaded), spacing25?: true (bonding both, the spacing along the route not known: the screen loss raised by 25 %, IEC 60287-1-1 2.3.4 b))}. $5.00 per calculation in USDC with x402; no free allowance; a list of up to 50 items at $5.00 per item, one payment.
